statements.quote: Revenues for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 are estimated to be in the range of $18.5 billion to $19.5 billion versus guidance of $14.5 billion to $15.5 billion, primarily due to increased demand for AI platforms.
statements.notes: Total revenue with AI demand named as the driver, not AI revenue itself. The figure is a preliminary, unaudited estimate for a completed quarter (Q1 FY2027, ended September 30, 2026), so it is recorded as actual. It covers one quarter, not the full fiscal year. The prior guidance of $14.5B–$15.5B in the same sentence is superseded and not recorded separately.
